characters.name: Tích
characters.description: Tích, a Vietnamese boy around ten, round face, big dark eyes, short messy black hair, yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans, white sneakers, small brown backpack, three heads tall.

characters.name: Nông Dân
characters.description: Nông Dân, a Sumerian farmer, adult man, three and a half heads tall, tan skin, thick black beard, black hair under a cream headband, plain cream tunic, bare feet, strong arms.

characters.name: Thư Lại
characters.description: Thư Lại, a Sumerian scribe, young adult, three and a half heads tall, tan skin, black hair in a topknot, cream tunic with blue trim, blue sash, bare feet, clay tablet in one hand.

characters.name: Vua Sumer
characters.description: Vua Sumer, a Sumerian king, adult man, three and a half heads tall, tan skin, thick black beard, tall blue and gold crown, blue robe with gold trim, gold armbands, white pleated skirt, bull-head staff.

backgrounds.name: Cổng thành Uruk

backgrounds.name: Ziggurat xa
backgrounds.description: stepped mudbrick ziggurat with a long ramp, sun-baked plaza, date palms

backgrounds.name: Kênh đào

backgrounds.name: Nhà bảng
backgrounds.description: scribal school interior, clay tablets stacked on low benches, oil lamp, mudbrick walls

backgrounds.name: Bến sông
backgrounds.description: muddy river dock, reed boats, cargo baskets, low wooden walkway, palm grove

backgrounds.name: Đồng muối
backgrounds.description: cracked salt-crusted field, dead palms, empty dry canal, pale sky

lighting.name: Trưa gắt

lighting.name: Chiều vàng

lighting.name: Đêm lửa
